basic_info.description: Welcome to this handsome 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath townhome residence nestled in the heart of Alamo Square, just a few blocks to the vibrant Hayes Valley. This home is the perfect single family home alternative offering modern luxury and classic charm, featuring a spacious living area with vaulted ceilings & gas fireplace; as well as two fantastic deeded outdoor spaces. The open floor plan is perfect for both entertaining and everyday living, with the bright living room flowing seamlessly from the gourmet kitchen. Step outside and discover your own private rooftop deck - an ideal space for enjoying Downtown views, and SF's stunning skyline and sunsets. The tranquil private backyard offers a serene retreat with plenty of space for gardening, grilling, or hosting outdoor gatherings; as well as an awesome place for those with dogs. With its prime location near Alamo Square Park, Hayes Valley and excellent dining, shopping, & transportation options this home offers the best of city living.
